extraction_notes: gross_fiscal_deficit_pct_gsdp is the post-audit figure from pages 16 and 39. revenue_deficit_pct_gsdp is the pre-audit figure from pages 33, 36, and 186, as a post-audit percentage was not explicitly provided. primary_deficit_pct_gsdp is from Appendix 1.4, Part E (page 186). debt_pct_gsdp is the 'Fiscal Liabilities/GSDP' figure, excluding the GST compensation loan, as consistently reported in tables (pages 36, 88, 186). interest_pct_revenue_receipts is consistently stated in the Executive Summary, Chapter I, and Chapter II (pages 17, 18, 63, 97). outstanding_debt_crore includes off-budget borrowings (page 39). raised_this_year is not explicitly stated. outstanding_over_5_years is the sum of cases from '5-10 years' to '25 and above' from Table 4.14 (page 173). pac_recommendations_pending is the total number of ATNs due for 2016-17, 2017-18, and 2018-19 from Table 4.16 (page 174), as PAC discussion for these years was not completed. money_value_of_observations_crore is from page 173.
